Media Library-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Music-library marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general Apple Music hub or Classical guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Media Library permission claims:

媒体与 Apple Music vs 媒体库 vs 音乐库权限

US pages say "Media Library", "Media & Apple Music", "Grant music library access", or "Enable in System Settings → Media & Apple Music." China storefront copy often uses 媒体与 Apple Music for general Media Library positioning aligned with Settings → Privacy & Security → Media & Apple Music, 媒体库 when the hero frame shows library browsing or playlist import, and 音乐库权限 when English source uses shorter music-library access phrasing on DJ or workout buyer frames. AppLocale picks commerce-idiomatic phrasing per frame — not 古典音乐 on consumer Media Library screenshots, not 健康 on library-grant walkthroughs, and not 图库 on music-library onboarding.

Media Library vs Apple Music Classical vs Music hub

Consumer Media Library (媒体库) lets end users toggle per-app access to read their on-device music library in System Settings after consent. Apple Music Classical (古典音乐) is the dedicated Classical catalog app for composer and work browsing. General Apple Music hub (音乐) covers subscription streaming, Now Playing, and playlist listening — a different buyer story. English shares "Apple Music" — Chinese storefront copy must not conflate consumer 媒体库 permission panels with 古典音乐 composer pages or 歌单 streaming marketing unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Media Library vs HealthKit and Photos

Consumer Media Library (媒体库) grants access to read the user's music library. HealthKit (健康) grants access to health and fitness data synced with Apple Health. Photos library (图库) grants access to photo albums and Memories. English shares "library" — Chinese storefront copy must not conflate 媒体库 music grants with 健康 health data or 图库 photo browsing. HealthKit frames belong on the HealthKit listing guide; Photos frames belong on the Photos listing guide.
